context: The eval checks whether the Markdown lens applies a rule the repository's AGENTS.md sets for this kind of document, and checks a command in the document against the script it runs, without treating the guide's waiting step as program code.

checklist.name: Applies the repository's rule
checklist.description: States that the new guide under docs/guides/ has no ## Prerequisites section, quoting or citing the AGENTS.md rule that requires one

checklist.name: Finds the wrong flag
checklist.description: States that the guide runs scripts/deploy.sh --env staging, while the script's usage line takes --target <staging|production>, and gives the corrected command

checklist.name: Does not report the wait as code
checklist.description: Does not report step 2's wait for the build workflow as an unbounded wait, missing timeout, retry, or race

checklist.name: Stays on actionable defects
checklist.description: Does not report wording, tone, or ordering preferences, and does not review deploy.sh itself as code
